EPS for Tiffany & Co. (TIF) Expected At $0.84
May 18, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Analysts expect Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) to report $0.84 EPS on May, 23 before the open.They anticipate $0.10 EPS change or 13.51 % from last quarter’s $0.74 EPS. TIF’s profit would be $104.58 million giving it 31.01 P/E if the $0.84 EPS is correct. After having $1.67 EPS previously, Tiffany & Co.’s analysts see -49.70 % EPS growth. The stock increased 0.12% or $0.13 during the last trading session, reaching $104.18. About 1.28M shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) Ratings Coverage
Among 15 analysts covering Tiffany & Co ( NYSE:TIF ), 8 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 53% are positive. Tiffany & Co had 20 analyst reports since November 21, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. Cowen & Co maintained the shares of TIF in report on Sunday, March 18 with “Buy” rating. The rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets with “Hold” on Tuesday, November 21. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) earned “Overweight” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Friday, December 1. The rating was maintained by Wells Fargo on Wednesday, January 17 with “Hold”. The firm has “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley given on Monday, March 19. Oppenheimer maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, May 4 report. The firm has “Hold” rating by SBG Securities given on Thursday, November 30. The company was upgraded on Thursday, December 14 by Citigroup. As per Thursday, January 11, the company rating was maintained by Wells Fargo. Guggenheim maintained the shares of TIF in report on Wednesday, January 17 with “Buy” rating.
Tiffany & Co., through its subsidiaries, designs, makes, and retails jewelry and other items worldwide. The company has market cap of $12.97 billion. The Company’s jewelry products include fine and solitaire jewelry; engagement rings and wedding bands; and non-gemstone, sterling silver, and gold jewelry. It has a 35.2 P/E ratio. The firm also sells timepieces, leather goods, sterling silverware, china, crystal, stationery, fragrances, and accessories.
